The issuer exhibits a solid financial profile with an EBIT margin of approximately 23.3% ($202M on $868M revenue), strong profitability relative to assets (ROA of ~2.7%), a healthy current ratio of 1.35x, and a moderate leverage profile reflected in an equity-to-assets ratio of 35.2%. While the earnings base is moderate in absolute terms ($868M revenue) compared to large investment-grade peers, the strong operating profitability and comfortable balance sheet support an investment-grade credit rating.

DECISION: BBB
